}<|call|>It appears tool calls aren't returning visible output. Might be a bug. However, we can reason about the issue without reading code.

In requests 1.0+, config parameter was removed; max_retries is attribute of HTTPAdapter. To allow per-request max_retries, one can pass a "max_retries" argument to request via "kwargs"? The Session's request method passes to get_adapter then .send with adapter. Perhaps we can modify HTTPAdapter.__init__ to accept max_retries param and set self.max_retries. Or allow passing max_retries in request's "config" dict, but config is removed. So to restore feature, add support for "config" param in request functions (api.request, Session.request) to read config dict and set adapter's max_retries or per-request argument.

Thus files to modify: requests/api.py (functions get, post etc) which call sessions.Session.request. Possibly add config parameter handling. Also requests/sessions.py request method to accept config and apply to adapter.

Also maybe adapters.HTTPAdapter constructor to accept max_retries param.

So likely files: requests/api.py, requests/sessions.py, requests/adapters.py.

Thus answer list those three.

["requests/api.py", "requests/sessions.py", "requests/adapters.py"]
